sources.snippet: cellpose-sam-onnx (CPSAM, FP16, browser-ready) Single-file FP16 ONNX export of Cellpose-SAM (CPSAM), the ViT-L-based cellular segmentation model from Stringer et al., 2025. Intended for in-browser inference via WebGPU through cellpose-js, but usable from any ONNX Runtime backend that supports opset 18 and FP16 graph IO.

sources.snippet: Cellpose-SAM: cell and nucleus segmentation with superhuman generalization. It can be optimized for your own data, applied in 3D, works on images with shot noise, (an)isotropic blur, undersampling, contrast inversions, regardless of channel order and object sizes.
